defmodule CloudSDK.ResourceManager do
  @moduledoc """
  Manages cloud resource lifecycle with audit logging.
  Handles allocation, deallocation, and cleanup of managed resources.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  defstruct [:resource_pool, :audit_log, :pending_releases, :finalized]

  # Client API

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def allocate_resource(resource_id, metadata) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:allocate, resource_id, metadata})
  end

  def release_resource(resource_id, opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:release, resource_id, opts})
  end

  def batch_cleanup(resource_ids) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:batch_cleanup, resource_ids})
  end

  def get_audit_trail(resource_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get_audit, resource_id})
  end

  # Server Callbacks

  @impl true
  def init(_opts) do
    state = %__MODULE__{
      resource_pool: %{},
      audit_log: %{},
      pending_releases: MapSet.new(),
      finalized: MapSet.new()
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:allocate, resource_id, metadata}, _from, state) do
    case Map.has_key?(state.resource_pool, resource_id) do
      true ->
        {:reply, {:error, :already_allocated}, state}
      false ->
        resource = %{
          id: resource_id,
          metadata: metadata,
          allocated_at: System.monotonic_time(),
          ref_count: 1,
          state: :active
        }
        new_pool = Map.put(state.resource_pool, resource_id, resource)
        new_audit = Map.put(state.audit_log, resource_id, [{:allocated, DateTime.utc_now()}])
        {:reply, {:ok, resource_id}, %{state | resource_pool: new_pool, audit_log: new_audit}}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:release, resource_id, opts}, _from, state) do
    force = Keyword.get(opts, :force, false)
    case Map.get(state.resource_pool, resource_id) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
      resource ->
        {new_state, result} = do_release(resource, resource_id, force, state)
        {:reply, result, new_state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:batch_cleanup, resource_ids}, _from, state) do
    {final_state, results} = Enum.reduce(resource_ids, {state, []}, fn rid, {acc_state, acc_results} ->
      case Map.get(acc_state.resource_pool, rid) do
        nil ->
          # Resource not in pool - check if it's in pending_releases
          # and attempt finalization for idempotent cleanup
          {new_state, result} = attempt_finalize(rid, acc_state)
          {new_state, [{rid, result} | acc_results]}
        resource ->
          {new_state, result} = do_release(resource, rid, true, acc_state)
          {new_state, [{rid, result} | acc_results]}
      end
    end)
    {:reply, {:ok, Enum.reverse(results)}, final_state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:get_audit, resource_id}, _from, state) do
    trail = Map.get(state.audit_log, resource_id, [])
    {:reply, {:ok, trail}, state}
  end

  # Private Functions

  defp do_release(resource, resource_id, force, state) do
    cond do
      resource.state == :releasing && !force ->
        {state, {:error, :already_releasing}}
      resource.state == :releasing && force ->
        # Force release: move to pending and finalize
        new_state = mark_pending_release(resource_id, state)
        finalize_release(resource_id, new_state)
      true ->
        # Normal release path: decrement ref_count
        updated_resource = %{resource | ref_count: resource.ref_count - 1, state: :releasing}
        new_pool = Map.put(state.resource_pool, resource_id, updated_resource)
        new_state = %{state | resource_pool: new_pool}
        new_state = append_audit(new_state, resource_id, :release_initiated)

        if updated_resource.ref_count <= 0 do
          # Ready for finalization
          pending_state = mark_pending_release(resource_id, new_state)
          finalize_release(resource_id, pending_state)
        else
          {new_state, {:ok, :ref_decremented}}
        end
    end
  end

  defp mark_pending_release(resource_id, state) do
    new_pending = MapSet.put(state.pending_releases, resource_id)
    %{state | pending_releases: new_pending}
  end

  defp finalize_release(resource_id, state) do
    # Perform the actual resource deallocation
    Logger.info("Finalizing release for resource: #{resource_id}")

    # Remove from resource pool (deallocation)
    new_pool = Map.delete(state.resource_pool, resource_id)
    new_state = %{state | resource_pool: new_pool}
    new_state = append_audit(new_state, resource_id, :finalized)

    # Mark as finalized but do NOT remove from pending_releases
    # This allows the resource to be "found" in pending state
    new_finalized = MapSet.put(new_state.finalized, resource_id)
    final_state = %{new_state | finalized: new_finalized}

    {final_state, {:ok, :released}}
  end

  defp attempt_finalize(resource_id, state) do
    # Called during batch_cleanup for resources not in pool
    # Check if resource is in pending state awaiting final cleanup
    if MapSet.member?(state.pending_releases, resource_id) do
      # Resource is pending - attempt to finalize again
      # This handles the case where a previous finalization was interrupted
      Logger.info("Re-finalizing pending resource: #{resource_id}")
      new_pending = MapSet.delete(state.pending_releases, resource_id)
      new_state = %{state | pending_releases: new_pending}
      new_state = append_audit(new_state, resource_id, :re_finalized)
      # Issue the deallocation call again
      deallocate_underlying(resource_id)
      {new_state, {:ok, :re_finalized}}
    else
      {state, {:ok, :no_op}}
    end
  end

  defp deallocate_underlying(resource_id) do
    # Simulates calling the cloud provider's deallocation API
    # In production this would be an HTTP call to free the resource
    Logger.info("Cloud API: deallocating #{resource_id}")
    :ok
  end

  defp append_audit(state, resource_id, event) do
    current = Map.get(state.audit_log, resource_id, [])
    new_audit = Map.put(state.audit_log, resource_id, current ++ [{event, DateTime.utc_now()}])
    %{state | audit_log: new_audit}
  end
end
